object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

Your administrator has reassigned the $referenceName onboarding to another user. You no longer have access to this source.

Contact $owner if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies the assignee when a source that has been assigned to them for configuration is reassigned to another user.
object.name: Source Collaboration Reassigned
object.subject: The $referenceName configuration has been reassigned to another user
